messages:
Eli (People Ops): Heads up 1: we have an exception request. Candidate Maya Patel for Staff ML Engineer. Manager requested compband E5 (guideline E4) + $40k sign-on; wants start 2026-05-04. Need routing.
Nora (Hiring Mgr): Agree on E5 for scope and org parity; team needs her by early May. Start 5/4 is target.
Diego (Recruiter): Candidate is finishing notice; confirmed 5/4 is feasible. Asked about benefits start date and relocation allowance timeline.
Samira (Compben): Please post proposed total comp and sign-on mechanics (tax gross-up? relocation?). Also note policy: sign-on > $35k needs VP approval and payroll notes for tax reporting.
Eli (People Ops): Proposed package pasted below:
````
base: $210,000
target bonus: $30,000
sign-on: $40,000 (20k immediate, 20k at 12 months contingent on employment)
equity: $120,000 (4yr, 1yr cliff)
relocation: $8,000 lump sum
total year1 cash (incl immediate sign-on): $260,000
````
Ravi (Finance): Budget ok if we structure sign-on 20/20 with retention clause. Recommend immediate portion capped at $20k now; remaining at 12 months. Need GL code and approve payroll timing. Also flag tax gross-up: we don't auto gross-up sign-ons unless relocation tied to tax equalization.
Nora (Hiring Mgr): Fine with 20/20. We need the full 40k to be communicated so candidate sees total comp. Manager will do 12mo success criteria.
Samira (Compben): Benefits eligibility: standard rule is first of month after start unless start before payroll cutoff and benefits admin can make same-day effective. For 5/4 start, benefits likely effective 6/1; can confirm with benefits admin. Relocation payout taxable, no gross-up by default. I'll draft offer language: sign-on split and 12-month retention clause + relocation taxed per local payroll.
Diego (Recruiter): Candidate asked if equity vests quarterly or monthly; also wants clarity on relocation timeline (pay within first 90 days).
Amara (VP People): I'll need full justification for E5: show market comp, leveling doc, and org comp ratio. Also approve sign-on >35k if rationale is strong. Tagging Samira for offer language.
Eli (People Ops): Pasted leveling doc link in GH: https://greenhouse.company/leveling/E5-summary (internal). Also attached benchmark table in GH- note: market 75th percentile supports E5.
offer-bot: Offer draft GH-54321 created. Routing people-ops -> compben -> finance -> vp-people.
Samira (Compben): Reviewed leveling doc and benchmarks. Rationale sufficient. Approving E5 exception to match market.
Ravi (Finance): Finance approves conditional on payroll GL mapping. We'll process 20k on first payroll after start, remaining 20k after payroll confirms 12-month tenure. Please include retention verification workflow.
Amara (VP People): Approving sign-on $40k (20k immediate, 20k at 12mo conditional). Approve E5 exception. Please ensure manager documents 12mo deliverables and keeps records for audit.
Eli (People Ops): Thanks all. Diego, please confirm candidate accepts verbal with those terms and get signed offer. Samira, please finalize benefits effective date language and relocation timing. Ravi, please confirm GL code back to me.
Diego (Recruiter): Candidate verbally accepted with minor Qs on equity vesting cadence. I'll update GH and include the relocation payout schedule (within 60-90 days).
offer-bot: Offer GH-54321 updated -> sent to candidate.
Eli (People Ops): Closing loop: set benefits packet to candidate, set benefits effective date per compben confirmation, add 12mo retention reminder on the managers calendar, and file exception approval in payroll folder. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
